quests.name: Stranded
quests.offer: My ship broke on these rocks, as yours did. Help me build one boat, and you may have it.
quests.thanks: She floats! Take this for the crossing.

steps.text: Mine copper ore in the crater north-east of camp.
Chop 20 ash logs in the grove north-west of camp, and bring them to the shipwright.
Smelt 8 copper bars at the furnace in camp, from two ore each, and bring them.
Pick 12 flax in the meadow south-west of camp, and bring it for the sail.
Smith a copper sword at the anvil, from three bars and an ash log. You will need it.
Cook a trail ration at the cooking fire in camp, from boar meat and berries.
Defeat Old Gnashclaw on the eastern sand. He swallowed the ship's wheel. When he opens a claw, step off the marked ground.
Bring the ship's wheel to the shipwright.
